defect.cause: Hood resembles a traveler, wrench jaw is partly lost in a short exposed shaft, and the feet narrow in the raised pose.
defect.approach: Work cap, gloves and tool-specific geometry shared across the paired control. In the refinement widen the foot plant and raise the wrench at an oblique angle.
